issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to use a method named `saveImage(filename)` to write the resulting image (problem_statement.md line 25). However, both the template and the solution provide a Bitmap class with a method named `save(const std::string &i_filename)` (Bitmap24::save declared in Bitmap24.hpp and used as bitmap.save(outfile) in main.cpp). There is no `saveImage` symbol in the template or solution. This name/signature mismatch will confuse students (they may look for a non-existent saveImage function) and could lead to incorrect implementations or needless search for the intended API.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the API naming consistent. Either (A) change the problem statement to instruct students to call Bitmap24::save(filename) (or refer to the exact signature e.g. save(const std::string&)) so it matches the provided code, or (B) add a small wrapper named saveImage(const std::string& filename) in the template (and solution) that forwards to bitmap.save(filename). Prefer (A) if the intended API is Bitmap24::save, as it avoids adding redundant wrappers and matches main.cpp usage.

issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to call a method named `saveImage(filename)` to write the resulting image to disk, but both the template and solution code expose a method named `save(const std::string &i_filename)` (class Bitmap24) and use `bitmap.save(outfile)`. This is an identifier naming mismatch: students following the problem text may implement or call `saveImage(...)` (which does not exist) and get compilation errors or become confused mapping the required API to the provided code.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the API name consistent across artifacts. Either (a) update the problem statement to refer to the existing method (e.g. "Verwenden Sie die Methode Bitmap24::save(filename) / save(filename)") or (b) add a `saveImage(const std::string &filename)` wrapper/alias in Bitmap24 (and forward it to the existing save) in the template/solution so the name referenced in the task exists. Prefer updating the problem text if the intended API is Bitmap24::save to avoid introducing redundant wrappers.
